policy_overview.purpose: Support UK exporters with financing guarantees and insurance

5_percent_rule.name: Revenue Threshold (5% Rule)
5_percent_rule.description: To be eligible for General Export Facility support, a business must show that in EACH of the last three (3) financial years, at least 5% of its annual turnover has been made up of export sales.
5_percent_rule.enforcement: Mandatory - must be met for all three years, not average

example.overall_status: ELIGIBLE - meets 5% threshold in all three years

20_percent_rule.name: Export Intensity (20% Rule)
20_percent_rule.description: For broader support (Export Development Guarantee), exporters usually need to show that export sales represent at least 20% of annual turnover in the last financial year, or on average over the last three years.
20_percent_rule.note: Kamil Changan at 5-7% does NOT meet this threshold - requires manual review

uk_content_requirement.name: UK Content Requirement
uk_content_requirement.description: At least 20% of the specific contract value must be UK-sourced (goods or services).

minimum_contract_value.name: Minimum Contract Value
minimum_contract_value.description: Transactions should be a minimum of £5 million
minimum_contract_value.sme_exception: SMEs have access to smaller facilities via General Export Facility (up to £25m total)
